author: Ogrey
body:
Special thanks to AwarriorVenom/Archeonixx (you will know once you read your skype, I put you as contributor on the YML, however if you like I can make you creator as well).

Hello guys! It is me Evocal bringing you all the third and last version of my first map ever, Justice!
What makes Justice 3 different from the other two its the monument amount (now has 3 instead of 2), obstacles scattered around the map (soulsand, cobwebs, water and sugar cane), whenever you kill a player, you will receive 1 diamond and 4 arrows (useful if you get a special item named Vintage Huntsman). However, if you die while carrying 2 or more diamonds, you will only give a single diamond to your killer, this way it will be easier to prevent diamond overpopulation.
I originally planned this map to have telepads, jump pads, sign loadouts, and some other crazy ideas I had during class. Hope you guys like it, thanks for your time and leave feedback if you wish!

Map Name: Justice 3
Map Creator: Evocal
Map Contributor: AwarriorVenom / Archeonixx
Download (YML inside .rar): https://www.mediafire.com/?0wlkylqva953oc4
Basic Info:
- Heroes (Yellow) vs Villains (Red)
- 45 vs 45 (90 players max)
- 3 monuments (Left, Back and Right)
- Custom loot (1 diamond, 4 arrows)
- Obstacles scattered around the map
- A wide amount of chests
- Special items
Map Images:

replies.body: The MapDevs already said if you just put "-1" or "+1" in a post without any reason, then this counts as spam and this is also a bad bump. If you would contribute the thread like saying "It looks very good, I like the (insert a part of the map)" or "I don't like it because (insert a map part)" this is all fine, but just a "-1" is not funny and spammy.
